description: Browse the structure of the Washington Administrative Code (WAC): with no cite, lists every WAC TITLE with the agency it belongs to (Title 296 = Labor and Industries, 458 = Revenue, 388 = Social and Health Services, 173 = Ecology, 246 = Health); with a title ("296") lists its CHAPTERS with captions; with a chapter ("296-800") lists its SECTIONS with captions and subheadings. Use to find which chapter covers a topic before calling wa_wac_section, or to enumerate every rule in a chapter. Keyless.

cite.description: Omit for all titles; a title number ("296") for its chapters; a chapter ("296-800") for its sections.

name: wa_wac_browse
